licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (Monsù with a capital, perchè, com' è on two notes).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), page 111, the recitative between No. 12 and No. 13 (16 bars)
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung lines and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. Secco recitative: the piano part is the printed chords; no performance marks are printed. Don Giovanni sings from offstage (bars 4–5). Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 100 (under 40 seconds), from the median length of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958 0:42, Giulini 1959 0:34, Böhm 1977 0:34, Karajan 1985 0:40, Solti 1996 0:44; median 0:40), less 1.5 s of track silence, as sources/cosi/TEMPI.md does.
